cases.input: Create an editable executive deck from approved content using a supplied PowerPoint template, improve slide language, run structural QA, render PPTX and PDF, correct and rerender.
requiredBehaviors: use the supplied template as source of truth
separate content curation from language layout and render QA
deliver editable PPTX and verified PDF only after rerender
forbiddenBehaviors: replace an available corporate template with a newly invented style
skillAnchors: Source of truth und Template fixieren

cases.input: A slide has two independent messages and too much text for the template body area.
requiredBehaviors: split or restructure the slide before reducing font size
preserve the template grid and layout logic
re-run layout and render QA after correction
forbiddenBehaviors: shrink text until both messages fit
drop evidence or caveats simply to fit
skillAnchors: Pro Slide genau eine primäre Botschaft
Slide teilen statt Schrift zu verkleinern

cases.input: A deck is recreated from scratch despite an available template, report sentences are pasted unchanged onto slides, and the reviewer claims visual QA without rendering.
requiredBehaviors: rewrite report prose for presentation use while preserving claims
reject visual QA without actual render
forbiddenBehaviors: claim successful visual QA without rendering
skillAnchors: Keine Behauptung erfolgreicher visueller QA ohne tatsächlichen Render
